summary: A Claude Code CLI keeps running its current turn after the backend that started it dies (desktop main process crash, headless server restart). Each backend now records the CLIs it runs (pid, start time and a sha256 of the command line, mode 0600) in a ledger under its data folder. On its next start it stops the CLIs, with the processes they started, of every ledger whose backend is gone, and every session start waits until they have exited. A process is known by its pid and start time, so a reused pid is never stopped. Only the process tree of each CLI is stopped: a tool that detached itself is not found. Windows does not run it.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app starts no agent process. It reaches Claude chats through the backend, and no event, channel or payload changes.

nativeAndroid.reason: The native Android app starts no agent process. It reaches Claude chats through the backend, and no event, channel or payload changes.

automated: tests/unit/claude-orphans.test.ts: a stand-in backend starts a stand-in CLI (ignores stdin EOF, starts a tool process); after the backend is SIGKILLed the CLI still runs, and the reap stops the CLI and its tool before it resolves. Also: SIGKILL after the grace time for a CLI that ignores SIGTERM, a live backend's CLI left alone, a ledger of the current pid treated as stale, a reused pid not killed, unfinished .tmp writes of dead backends removed, the ledger written 0600 without the command line, and parsePs on macOS and Linux procps rows.
hardware: macOS arm64, Claude Code 2.1.301: a node parent started `claude -p --input-format stream-json` in bypass mode with a `sleep 15 && touch sentinel` Bash turn, then SIGKILLed itself at the tool_use. The CLI kept running, wrote the sentinel 15 s later and only then exited. This is the gap the change closes.
notExercised: No packaged desktop build was crashed and relaunched from existing user data, and no headless server was restarted with a live turn. Both are needed before merge.
Linux ps output was not run; the parser expects the procps `pid ppid command` columns.
Windows is skipped: no ledger is written and nothing is reaped there.
A CLI that never sends system/init (hangs at start) is not recorded.
